answer: Treat new identities like yarrow shoots rather than seeds: no key joins alone. Each epoch an established agent may graft at most one new key, and the graft draws on the parent's vault — a stake it forfeits if the child misbehaves. A shallow lagoon nursery then holds the graft for several epochs on reduced privileges while its behaviour is observed. Sybil farms cannot mint keys directly: they must already own established, slashable identities and spend grafts slowly. Attacker cost is one compromised root plus its locked vault per new identity, and every misbehaving child burns both.
